outline:
文創作為跨域產業，橫跨影音媒介、當代策展至體驗設計，是集結感官與創意的全球關鍵領域。本課程採英語授課（EMI），連結全球文創最前沿的個案與文本，範疇涵蓋影視 IP 授權、當代展演、品牌符號到 AI 世代下的數位浪潮。

課堂透過參與式討論、動態提案與個案拆解等方式，培養學生的跨文化溝通與論述能力，進而轉化為具備國際視野與當代轉譯力的文創實踐者。

Cultural and creative industries represent an interdisciplinary sector—spanning audio-visual media, contemporary curating, and experience design—forming a pivotal global domain that unites sensation with creativity. Taught in English (EMI), this course connects students with cutting-edge international case studies and texts, ranging from film/TV IP licensing and contemporary exhibitions to brand semiotics and digital trends in the AI era.
Through interactive discussions, dynamic pitching, and case breakdowns, students will sharpen their cross-cultural communication skills and industry discourse, transforming into creative practitioners equipped with a global vision and contemporary storytelling capability.
